tools.name: get_restaurant_info
tools.description: Basic facts about Sole Mio Kitchen & Bar: address, phone, email, website, cuisine, features, rating and key links (reserve, order, catering). Use for 'where is it / how do I contact them'.

tools.name: get_hours
tools.description: Opening hours of Sole Mio (America/New_York). With a date: that day's hours plus lunch/brunch/happy-hour/early-bird windows; without: today, open-now status and the weekly schedule. Holidays may differ - call to confirm.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Menu with USD prices. No arguments: overview of menus and their sections. With section: the items (name, description, price or size prices). With dietary: only items carrying that marker. Prices are before tax.

tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Search all menu items by name or description (case-insensitive; every word must match). Returns up to 15 items with prices and diet markers.

tools.name: get_specials
tools.description: Promotions and recurring offers (Early Bird, weekend brunch, lunch, happy hour, Wine Wednesday, Comfort Tuesday, Supper Club, kids pizza). With a day: only what runs that day, with times.

tools.name: get_early_bird
tools.description: Early Bird Dinner details: days and times, prices (Friends of Sole Mio vs regular), what is included, the 8 entrees with their Toast prices, and the rules.

tools.name: get_reservation_link
tools.description: Build a Toast Tables booking deep link for a date, time and party size (online booking works for 1-10 guests; 11 or more must call). Checks the day is not Monday (closed) and flags times outside opening hours. The guest completes the booking at the link.

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: Online ordering link (Toast) for pickup and Sole Mio's own delivery, with the delivery fee and related notes.

tools.name: get_catering_and_events_info
tools.description: Catering, group dining (tables of 4-20) and private events (venue up to 120): what is offered, links, and how to send an inquiry (submit_inquiry).

tools.name: get_loyalty_info
tools.description: Friends of Sole Mio loyalty program: how to join (free), rewards at 3/5/10 visits, Early Bird member price.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send a catering / private event / group-dining inquiry to the restaurant team. ONLY call when the person explicitly asked to be contacted and gave their name and phone or email. Rate-limited. The restaurant replies by phone or email within one business day.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_restaurant_info · Private data: get_restaurant_info, get_catering_and_events_info, submit_inquiry · Public sink: get_restaurant_info, get_catering_and_events_info, submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_restaurant_info · Private data: get_restaurant_info, get_catering_and_events_info, submit_inquiry · Public sink: get_restaurant_info, get_catering_and_events_info, submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
